tracking_method: A temporary host-only copy transforms value reads into checked getters and tracks real helper output writes. Only initializedness/writer metadata is initialized, never float values. Unsafe inputs stop before an unwritten read and are never executed through the untouched C body. The tracked copy is not compiled by IDO, scored, submitted or substituted for the matching source.
oracles: Independent caller state/call-trace model, host consumption-tracked copy and untouched C agree for all612 safe fixtures. Exact IDO whole-body equality is separately established by verification.json; these are not claimed native-emulator fixture counts.
observation_boundary: Snapshot immediately on entry to final external1DC08. Its internal effects and full spatial/audio-engine helper algorithms are outside this caller unit proof; test helpers implement explicit modular contracts.
host_mode: C89 pedantic-errors, Wall/Wextra/Werror, ffp-contract=off, ASan/UBSan. Only leak detection disabled for executor ptrace compatibility; no candidate/C-harness heap allocation.
limits: Every actually consumed float must have been written in this invocation, possibly by a prior iteration. Empty-list CalcEmitter may write only volume/pitch. Valid allocated acyclic emitters, bounded helper pools/groups, coherent callback contracts and ordinary finite FP are required. Original fade value, global producer/listener invariant, actual spatial/audio-engine execution, arbitrary concurrency and malformed-input safety remain unproved.
comparison_precision: The entire normalized caller state and external call trace are folded into a32-bit FNV-1a digest. Agreement is bounded regression evidence, not exhaustive semantic equivalence or a collision-free comparison.
